meta.title: Open Science Dataset Registration Wizard
meta.description: 100% declarative schema. All business logic, APIs, conditions and output mapping are here.
meta.changelog: 3.0.0 - No-code backend: all mappers are declarative in JSON. Python = generic engine only.

fields.label: Publication Year
fields.help: Year when the dataset will be or was published

fields.label: Resource Link or Identifier
fields.help: Add a related resource identifier (URL, DOI, PMID, ARK, etc.).

fields.label: Publisher Name
fields.help: Official publisher name used for DataCite metadata.

fields.label: Search Publisher (ROR)
fields.help: Search publisher in ROR. Selection updates publisher name and identifier.

fields.label: Search Organization (ROR)
fields.help: Search ROR registry for the organization. Selection updates the organization name and identifier.

fields.label: ORCID iD
fields.help: Search ORCID registry. Fill in given name and family name above to pre-populate the search.

fields.label: Affiliation (ROR)
fields.help: Search ROR registry for the affiliation institution.

fields.label: Search Organization (ROR)
fields.help: Search ROR registry for the organization. Selection updates the organization name and identifier.

fields.label: ORCID iD
fields.help: Search ORCID registry. Fill in given name and family name above to pre-populate the search.

fields.label: Affiliation (ROR)
fields.help: Search ROR registry for the affiliation institution.

fields.label: Strain or Line
fields.help: Search for genetic background or strain. Required for mouse and rat models.

fields.label: Cross-species gene / transgene

options.label: Search gene in all species (humanized knock-in, transgenic or cross-species model)

fields.help: Check this if the gene or mutation originates from a different species than the host organism (e.g. human APOE4 knock-in in mouse, AAV-human transgene in primate).

fields.label: Gene Symbol, Name or Identifier
fields.help: Select an organism model first, then search gene (Apoe, MGI:88057, ENSMUSG...). Selecting a gene enables allele search.

fields.label: Transgene / Gene origin species
fields.help: Species from which the gene or mutation originates. Stored as a DataCite subject for cross-species traceability.

fields.label: Gene Chromosome Location
fields.help: Chromosomal locus used for allele search (expected format: chr:start-end). Auto-filled from MyGene when possible, otherwise enter manually.

fields.label: Allele (Mutation)
fields.help: Optional but recommended. For mouse: shows MouseMine/MGI first + Alliance results. For rat, zebrafish, fruit fly: uses Alliance Genome (RGD/ZFIN/FlyBase). For C. elegans: type the GENE SYMBOL (e.g. 'nspg-9') in the search box to retrieve WormBase alleles from Alliance Genome. For primates: use the dedicated free-text allele and mutation fields below instead. If selected, it overrides gene precision.

fields.label: Allele Identifier (free text)
fields.help: For primates, no curated allele database is available via API. Enter the allele or variant identifier manually (e.g. dbSNP rs ID, Ensembl variant ID, or custom lab identifier).
fields.placeholder: E.g. rs123456, ENSVAR..., custom allele ID

fields.label: Mutation Type (free text)
fields.help: Describe the mutation type manually for primate datasets (e.g. missense, deletion, insertion).

fields.label: Strain / Line (Mutant)
fields.help: For Xenopus, use mutant strains/lines from Xenbase linked to the selected gene.

fields.label: Line Type
fields.help: Preferred Xenbase values: Mutant, Transgenic, Wild-Type strain.

fields.label: Molecule (ChEBI)
fields.help: Search for chemical compounds in the ChEBI ontology. Manual entry allowed if not found.

fields.label: Treatment Protocol
fields.help: Indicate whether the treatment is acute or chronic.

fields.label: Treatment Design / Administration
fields.help: Provide free text with guideline: dose with unit, route, number of doses, duration, frequency, anesthesia, vehicle. Example: '50 mg/kg, IP, 3 doses, 7 days, 1x/day, anesthesia: none, vehicle: saline 0.9%'

fields.label: Diet (EFO)
fields.help: Search for dietary interventions in the Experimental Factor Ontology.
fields.placeholder: E.g. High fat diet, Caloric restriction, Western diet…

fields.label: Modeled Disease (DOID)
fields.help: Search for diseases in the Disease Ontology. Describe the disease model used in your study.
fields.placeholder: E.g. Alzheimer disease, Type 2 diabetes mellitus…

fields.label: Tissue or Organ (UBERON)
fields.help: Search for anatomical structures in the UBERON ontology.
